value: **How far these comparisons repeat.** All four experiments were run again on 24 November 2026 (section 7). The mean CRPS of a model in an experiment changed by at most 0.027 points, or 2.6%. In experiments A, B and C, 124 of the 126 differences between models in the table above gave the same verdict as before (interval below zero, above zero, or including it). In experiment D only 12 of 20 did, so no ranking of the models should be read from experiment D.
